scope: Overall optional application-cursor integration: core setting, GUI/profile/MCP setting path, desktop selection, host observer, Rust target observer/protocol, overlay composition, explicit fixture, isolated optional C++ bridge and packaging paths.

independent_observer_review.scope: Historical base observer approval; current receive/retry delta independently covered by source_fix_review.

resolved_material_findings: C++ Start now compares the explicit ObserverSuccess=0 ABI and Stop retains the attachment on failure.
Stock classification uses the original target-local shared handle before CopyIcon; only custom images own asynchronous copied icons.
Explicit fixture handles WM_SETCURSOR with the stored virtual region and normalizes child mouse coordinates to its own root client.
STOPPED publication and clearing the old observer global share the Start lifecycle gate, closing the acknowledged-restart interleaving.
Selected-target capability is queried with the actual follow flag even while disabled; architecture absence is authoritative before enabling, without allocating an observer.
The ordinary backend exit tick reaps acknowledged stopped observer bindings for every attached target, including old selections never revisited.

Native malformed-snapshot failure repaired: post-receive request pairing, retained valid publication retry, and valid missing-data fallback; two focused production-transition regressions reviewed in the linked addendum.
reviewed_invariants: No new host cursor query/movement; selected PID/HWND/attachment/association/request generations are checked. No foreign cursor handle or custom pixel payload is exposed through routing_state.

Optional exports and architecture DLL availability retain configured fallback; provider failures remain local status and do not fail ordinary routing. Stopped/disabled mapping ownership remains bounded until acknowledgement or original process exit.
Fixed header and bounded copied payload reject malformed dimensions, hotspot, reserved/status fields and non-premultiplied bytes before rendering.

Custom image origin subtracts scaled hotspot; source-over premultiplied composition preserves opaque black and alpha, label/badge placement, and cached same-image metadata updates. Hidden app imagery preserves configured labels/badges.

Default follow_application=false preserves older JSON. Actual Theme checkbox uses routing_settings/profile state, not routing_output; unavailable runtime capability disables the control without discarding the saved preference.

Both isolated and consolidated vendor patches reverse-check against the frozen worktree; optional C++ forwarding stays separate from Rust rendering/publication. Portable scripts include both observer DLLs; packaging is not executed by this review.

Final capability/reaping delta: cursor_available is checked before the !enabled no-allocation branch; only active previous selection is disabled on target changes. Reaping uses zero-timeout coherent STOPPED inspection and releases host references after acknowledgement.
checks_performed: Read-only reverse application checks for both native patches
Runner AST/helper callback review; no apps or Cargo
limits: No runtime/native/pixel/lifecycle acceptance from this report; final producer and finite native gate remain separate.

ShowCursor forwards its immediate event rather than full display-counter semantics; animated/all cursor APIs, arbitrary applications, physical devices, mixed DPI and same-process independence are not established.
High-rate Motion queue pressure is unperformed P6 work, not an added acceptance workload.
Malformed/out-of-order timing cases have only the specific protocol unit/source evidence; no artificial native fault injection is proposed.
